cards.ex: I almost lost my cool when the internet went down right before my presentation.
cards.exUz: Mening taqdimotimdan oldin internet o'chganda, deyarli jahlim chiqib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni tuta olmay, g'azablanish yoki asabiylashish.

cards.ex: I wanted to argue, but I had to bite my tongue to avoid a fight.
cards.exUz: Men bahslashmoqchi edim, lekin urushmaslik uchun tilimni tiyishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir aytishni xohlasangiz ham, o'zingizni tiyib turish.

cards.ex: His constant complaining is really starting to test my patience.
cards.exUz: Uning doimiy shikoyatlari meni chindan ham sabrimni sinayapti.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa yoki kimdir sizni asabiylashtirib, sabringizni tugatmoq.

cards.ex: Patience is a virtue, especially when dealing with difficult customers.
cards.exUz: Sabr - bu fazilat, ayniqsa qiyin mijozlar bilan muomala qilganda.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi xulq-atvor, yaxshi odat; sabr ham shunday fazilat.

cards.ex: I'm running out of patience with his excuses.
cards.exUz: Men uning bahonalariga sabrim tugayapti.
cards.uzDef: Nimanidir ishlatib bo'lish yoki yo'qotib qo'yish, sabrga nisbatan ham.

cards.ex: It might be difficult now, but it will be worth it in the long run.
cards.exUz: Hozir qiyin bo'lishi mumkin, lekin uzoq muddatda buning qadri bor.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda, uzoq vaqt o'tgandan keyin; sabr bilan kutish kerak bo'lgan vaziyatlarda.

cards.ex: Take it easy, we have plenty of time to finish the project.
cards.exUz: Oson qabul qiling, loyihani tugatishga yetarli vaqtimiz bor.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatga xotirjamlik bilan yondashish, asabiylashmaslik.

cards.ex: I've been on edge all day waiting for the results.
cards.exUz: Men butun kun natijalarni kutib asabiy bo'lib yurdim.
cards.uzDef: Asabiy yoki xavotirda bo'lish, sabrsizlanish.

cards.ex: Don't let his comments get to you.
cards.exUz: Uning izohlari sizga ta'sir qilmasin.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa sizni asabiylashtirsa yoki xafa qilsa.

cards.ex: Cool your jets, we'll get there eventually.
cards.exUz: Tinchlan, biz u yerga oxir-oqibat yetib boramiz.
cards.uzDef: Xotirjam bo'ling, shoshilmang; sabrliroq bo'lishga chaqiriq.

cards.ex: Hold your horses! Let's think this through first.
cards.exUz: Shoshilmang! Keling, avval buni yaxshilab o'ylab ko'raylik.
cards.uzDef: Sekinroq, shoshilmang, kutib turing.

cards.ex: I didn't mean to snap at you, I'm just stressed.
cards.exUz: Men sizga baqirishni xohlamagan edim, shunchaki stressdaman.
cards.uzDef: Asabiylashib, birdaniga qattiq gapirmoq.

cards.ex: He's got a short fuse, so be careful what you say.
cards.exUz: U tez jahldor, shuning uchun nima deyishingizga e'tibor bering.
cards.uzDef: Tez g'azablanadigan, sabri kam odam.

cards.ex: I was patiently waiting for my turn.
cards.exUz: Men o'z navbatimni sabrlik bilan kutdim.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday shikoyat qilmasdan uzoq vaqt kutish.

cards.ex: The job offer is a waiting game now; we just have to be patient.
cards.exUz: Ish taklifi hozir kutish o'yini; biz shunchaki sabrli bo'lishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nimanidir kutishni talab qiladigan vaziyat.

cards.ex: He knows exactly how to push my buttons.
cards.exUz: U mening asabimga qanday tegishni juda yaxshi biladi.
cards.uzDef: Sizni asabiylashtiradigan yoki g'azablantiradigan narsa qilish.

cards.ex: Easy does it when you're moving that heavy box.
cards.exUz: O'sha og'ir qutini ko'chirayotganda sekin-asta harakat qiling.
cards.uzDef: Sekin va ehtiyotkorlik bilan harakat qilish; sabrli bo'lish.

cards.ex: His constant interruptions are really trying my patience.
cards.exUz: Uning doimiy xalaqit berishi mening sabrimni sinayapti.
cards.uzDef: Sizni asabiylashtiradigan yoki sabringizni tugatadigan narsa qilish.

cards.ex: You need to get a grip and calm down.
cards.exUz: Siz o'zingizni tutishingiz va tinchlanishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni boshqarish, asabiylashmaslik.

cards.ex: I'm at my wit's end trying to fix this computer.
cards.exUz: Men ushbu kompyuterni tuzatishga urinib, chorasiz qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Chorasiz qolgan, nima qilishni bilmaydigan holat.

cards.ex: Slow your roll, we have plenty of time.
cards.exUz: Sekinroq, bizda yetarli vaqt bor.
cards.uzDef: Shoshilmang, sekinroq harakat qiling.

cards.ex: I'm starting to lose patience with this slow service.
cards.exUz: Bu sekin xizmatdan sabrim tugayapti.
cards.uzDef: Sabrni yo'qotish, asabiylashish.

cards.ex: Keep your shirt on, I'm almost finished.
cards.exUz: Tinchlaning, men deyarli tugatdim.
cards.uzDef: Asabiylashmang, xotirjam bo'ling.

cards.ex: When I get stressed, I just breathe deeply and try to relax.
cards.exUz: Stressga tushsam, men shunchaki chuqur nafas olaman va dam olishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni tinchlantirish uchun chuqur nafas olish.

cards.ex: It takes practice restraint to not react immediately.
cards.exUz: Darhol javob bermaslik uchun o'zini tiyish kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni tutish, biror narsa qilishdan saqlanish.

cards.ex: Give him a few minutes to simmer down.
cards.exUz: Unga sovishi uchun bir necha daqiqa bering.
cards.uzDef: Tinchlanmoq, g'azabdan tushmoq.

cards.ex: My boss keeps me on a short leash.
cards.exUz: Mening boshlig'im meni qattiq nazorat ostida ushlab turadi.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq nazorat ostida bo'lish.

cards.ex: She can withstand pressure better than anyone I know.
cards.exUz: U men bilganlardan ko'ra bosimga yaxshiroq bardosh bera oladi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatlarga yoki bosimga chidash.

cards.ex: It's always the calm before the storm when things are going too smoothly.
cards.exUz: Ishlar juda silliq ketayotganda, bu har doim bo'ron oldidan sokinlik.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatdan oldin tinchlik.

cards.ex: We just have to wait it out and see what happens.
cards.exUz: Biz shunchaki kutib o'tirishimiz va nima bo'lishini ko'rishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning o'tib ketishini kutish.
